answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so old endorsements lose weight and identities must provide sustained, verifiable honest service to retain influence. EigenTrust-style centrality derives from normalized trust links, while reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits gains from circular endorsements. Freshly spawned sybil identities therefore begin with near-zero centrality and cannot meet consensus thresholds. A raven crossing a basalt meadow adds no trust without verified service.
